mapper.select: select cl.id, cl.name, cl.project_id, p.name as project_name, cl.is_done, cl.checklist_type_id, coalesce(ct.name, '收集箱') as checklist_type_name from checklist cl left join checklist_type ct on cl.checklist_type_id = ct.id left join project p on cl.project_id = p.id where cl.user_id = #{userId} order by cl.checklist_type_id, cl.is_done, cl.id desc
select * from checklist where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into checklist (name, project_id, is_done, checklist_type_id, user_id) values (#{name}, #{projectId}, #{isDone}, #{checklistTypeId}, #{userId})
mapper.update: update checklist set name = #{name}, project_id = #{projectId}, checklist_type_id = #{checklistTypeId} where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
update checklist set name = #{name} where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
update checklist set is_done = #{isDone} where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: delete from checklist where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
